title: Scaling limit for the pinning model in correlated Gaussian environment beyond the $L^2$-regime
summary: In this paper, we study the scaling limit of the pinning model in correlated Gaussian environment. The tail probability of the underlying renewal process of the model has a polynomial decay with exponent $α>0$. The covariance of the Gaussian environment $\{ω_n\}_{n\in\mathbb N}$ is given by $\text{Cov}_{\mathbb P}(ω_n,ω_m)\sim |n-m|^{2H-2}$ with $H\in(0,1)$.
